## What problem does this solve?

<!-- Describe the problem from your own experience. What were you doing, what
     went wrong or was missing, and why did it matter?

     "It would be cool if..." is not a problem statement. -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What specifically do you want to happen? Be concrete. -->

## What alternatives did you consider?

<!-- What other approaches could solve the same problem? Why is your proposal

## Is this appropriate for core AIEA?

<!-- AIEA v1 is a framework-only, host-neutral skills library. It does not
     include an orchestration engine, application, hosted service, installer,
     telemetry, or benchmark runner. Check the
     [v1 scope](https://github.com/himanshu231204/ai-engineering-army/blob/main/docs/version-1.md)
     and answer:

     - Would this benefit someone working on a completely different kind of
       project than yours?
     - Is it specific to your domain, team, or tool?
     - Does it integrate or promote a third-party service?
     - Does it keep the canonical skills host-neutral?

     Host-specific packaging and discovery belong under `adapters/`. -->

## Environment (required)

<!-- Required. We weigh proposals reasoned from documentation differently from
     ones grounded in a real session where the problem actually came up. -->

|---|---|
| AIEA version or commit | |
| Host (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) | |
| Host version | |
| Your model + version | |
| Install method (plugin, ZIP, source checkout) | |
